t: You're looking at St Alban's Church, a Church of England parish church in Holborn, in the area commonly called Hatton Garden. It has been Grade II* listed since 1951. It was designed by William Butterfield, a Gothic Revival architect associated with the Oxford Movement and noted for his use of polychromy, which means patterned colour in the building materials. William Allen Whitworth is buried here. He was a mathematician and a priest in the Church of England.
